children: Meenal Raje-Bhatt takes charge of global Sales Finance capabilities as Unilever advances finance transformation and AI-led operating models

Unilever has appointed Meenal Raje-Bhatt as Director, with effect from June 2026. In her new role, she is leading the establishment of Global Sales Finance capabilities while working on finance transformation through organisation redesign, SAP S/4HANA transformation, process standardisation and AI-first ways of working.

Raje-Bhatt brings more than 13 years of experience with Unilever across controllership, financial reporting, sales finance, business partnering, P&L management, exports finance and finance transformation. She has also worked with Avendus Capital earlier in her career.

In her current role, Raje-Bhatt is responsible for establishing Global Sales Finance capabilities across Unilever businesses. Her mandate also includes reworking finance operations through changes to organisational structures, standardised processes and technology-led operating models.
The role combines finance operations with digital transformation, including the implementation and adoption of SAP S/4HANA and AI-enabled approaches to finance work.

Before taking the Director role, Raje-Bhatt served as Group Financial Accountant at Hindustan Unilever from January 2024 to May 2026, overseeing financial reporting, record-to-report, statutory compliance, payroll accounting and funds management.
She also led the finance workstream for the operational separation of Hindustan Unilever’s Ice Cream business, working across finance, technology and business teams during the transition.
Earlier, she was Senior Manager, Sales Finance, where she worked with sales and technology teams on digital commercial capabilities and trade-spend optimisation.
Between 2020 and 2022, Raje-Bhatt served as Finance Business Partner for Personal Care India at Hindustan Unilever, with end-to-end P&L responsibility for a portfolio valued at more than Rs 8,000 cr.
She had earlier led finance for the exports business and worked as Controls Manager, covering SOX and IFC responsibilities.
Raje-Bhatt began her career at Avendus Capital, where she worked in the Digital Media and Technology team.

Her expanded mandate comes as finance functions increasingly combine traditional reporting and controllership responsibilities with technology, data and automation. At Unilever, her role places sales finance capabilities alongside broader changes in finance operating models.
Raje-Bhatt is a Chartered Accountant and holds a postgraduate management qualification from the Indian Institute of Management Bangalore. She also completed an exchange term at HEC Paris.
